sources.snippet: The BenchLM Reasoning Leaderboard scores general-purpose language models on a private held-out set of multi-step reasoning problems. Scores are the mean of three runs and are reported out of 100. This page introduces the methodology; the ranking table follows below. Nothing in this introductory paragraph contains an individual model score. Evaluated on the BenchLM-Reasoning v4 suite. Population: 1

sources.snippet: About BenchLM BenchLM is an independent evaluation project. We publish reasoning, coding and retrieval leaderboards, describe our methodology openly, and re-run every suite quarterly. Methodology Each model is run three times against a held-out problem set. We report the mean. Runs are executed on identical hardware with identical decoding parameters. We do not accept payment from model providers
